text: I know you're alive!\nCome on! Wake up!!
Looks like you have come to a different place\nwhile you were unconscious...\nA wall and a gate can be seen from a distance...
It's totally different from our world, isn't it?
...So, there might be monsters that we've never\nseen, right...?
Awwww... H-Hey! Hey!\nI-I-I can see a town over there!\nW-Why don't we go that way?
There is quicksand.\nDo you want to proceed?
